facility.name: Tiny Tots Childcare
facility.programs_provided: Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 299 LAKE FORK DR, EMORY, TX, 75440

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: At the inspection, 3 out of 3 children's records reviewed did not include a health care provider statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: At the inspection, 2 out of 3 children's records reviewed did not have the address for the emergency contact in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information related to having an unassigned epipen available for emergency situations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §746.501(a)(29))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: At the inspection, two out of four training records reviewed did not complete their hours within the training year.  Two caregivers need 9 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: At the inspection, the operation did not have a working carbon monoxide detection system.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At the inspection, the grass on the playground was knee high and needs to be mowed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient.  The children in the infant classroom were moved into another room in January after a frozen pipe busted in the classroom. The classroom was not tested for mold until 2 months later and the result was positive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Report of Criminal Complaint Against Employees: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient. The operation did not notify Child Care Regulation about an arrest of one of the caregivers employed at the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report of Criminal Complaint Against Employees (26 TAC §746.305(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: At the inspection, two caregivers violated the conditions set by CBCU by being left alone with a group of children in care at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information regarding having an unassigned epinephrine  auto injector at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §746.501(a)(29))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children: At the inspection, two infants  age 7 months and 15 months were present on the playground with the older children through age 7 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children (26 TAC §746.2403(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: At the inspection, 2 out of 2 personnel training records reviewed did not meet the required 24 hours of annual training. One caregiver needs 14 hours of training and the other caregiver needs 11 hours of annual training for the 2023 training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: At the inspection, the director has recorded 9 hours of annual training and needs 21 hours of training to complete  the 2023 training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information supporting inclusive services for children with special needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient.  The children present were combined in a classroom together ages 7 months to 5 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient.  A caregiver allowed children age 3 & 4 years old to play in the front parking area of the operation and not be fenced or in an enclosed outdoor activity space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: At the investigation inspection, it was determined the fire inspection expired as of 2/24/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: 11/2/23- At the follow-up inspection, one caregiver needs 5 hours of training to complete the training year.     At the inspection, 2 caregivers did not meet the 24 hour requirement of annual training, one caregiver needs 19 hours of training and the other needs 3 hours of annual training for the training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information related to accessing the HHSC website.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §746.501(a)(23))

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: At the inspection, 2 out of 4 children's records reviewed did not include information of receiving the operational policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: At the inspection, the practice drills documentation was incomplete for half of the 2023 year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: At the inspection, the director did not meet the 30 hours of required annual training for the training year and needs 12 hours of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: At the inspection, 2 caregivers did not meet the 24 hour requirement of annual training, one caregiver needs 19 hours of training and the other needs 3 hours of annual training for the training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information related to maintaining and administering unassigned ephinephrine injectors for use during an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §746.501(a)(29))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: At the inspection, the operational poilcy did not include information related to services for children with special needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information related to preventing and respnding to abuse and neglect of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: At the inspection, 3 out of the 4 children's records reviewed did not include a health care provider statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient.  The infant caregiver is not sharing a daily report with parents of infant children every day of the week.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient.  It was determined the caregiver was taking infant children to the playground one at a time, leaving the room with one infant and leaving the other infants unsupervised in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Pre-service Training- Developmental Stages: At the inspection, one caregiver that started in May 2022 did not have proof of having completed pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pre-service Training- Developmental Stages (26 TAC §746.1305(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: At the inspection, the director and the two caregivers did not have current first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include the information related to the promotion of indoor/outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training: At the inspection, the director needs 22 hours of training for the prior training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: At the inspection, one caregiver needs to complete 24 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: At the inspection, the director and the caregivers present did not have current CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found deficient.  The operation failed to self-report a positive case of Covid within the required 48 hours.  The operation was informed by a teacher that was positive on 8/4/22 and did not report until 8/10/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: At the inspection, the director did not have annual training hours for the year 2020-2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 3 out of 4 childrens records reviewed did not have the information required for emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection for the operation has expired and is dated 7/27/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include the indoor/outdoor physical activity information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: At the inspection, the caregiver was not expressing positive language or encouraging good behavior with children playing in centers and at clean up time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: At the inspection, a bottle was present in the crib of a 10 month old sleeping infant. The operation corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: 3 out of 4 childrens records reviewed at the inspection did not include the emergency care authorization information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: At the inspection, the director did not have annual training hours for the year 2020-2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 out of 4 children's records reviewed at the inspection did not include a current immunization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
